race.comment: Good little race this. SET ME LOOSE (5) was a dominant winner first up at Seymour as favourite before an even effort at Caulfield where the leader ran along and won easily. She got home well enough there for fourth and can roll forward here. YUUKI (6) was sound behind the talented Cruiserweight two back at Swan Hill before really measuring up well in the Listed Lightning Stakes in Adelaide behind Cavalry Girl who has won dominantly again since. She draws well and rates nicely. PRAISE HER (10) was well backed and won accordingly on debut at Pakenham Synthetic, scoring by 2.25 lengths. In the right yard and should keep improving. ALMOST AN ANGEL (12) resumes having shown good ability at two, watch the betting. ICED POPPY (9) struggled last time but had been good fresh, in the mix.
